What is a subject code? Where do I find it?

Every subject has its own code, given by the university. Look for it next to the subject name on your syllabus, timetable or lab manual.

Example: Data Structures using C-Lab has the code BTCSAIML307P

Can’t find it? Ask your teacher or your class representative.
